next.reason: 1985: 'The text produced as a result of the complete processing of a COPY statement must not contain a COPY statement.'; 2023: 'If the REPLACING phrase is not specified, the library text may contain a COPY statement that does not include a REPLACING phrase.'. 1985 bars any COPY in copied text. 2023 allows nested COPY (at least 5 levels) without REPLACING and bars COPY only with REPLACING or when the replacing action introduces one.
